SELECT cs.store_id, cp.subcategory, r.reason_code, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ids, SUM(r.quantity_returned) units, MIN(r.quantity_returned) minq, MAX(r.quantity_returned) maxq
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  AND cp.category='Garden' AND cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(1,2,3) ORDER BY 1,3

calls.statement:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.*, cp.category, cp.subcategory
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
    AND cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r) n,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM r) dist_ret_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM r) dist_sales_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL) orphans,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date < f.sale_date) before_sale,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.quantity_returned > f.quantity) over_qty,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.product_key<>r.product_key) prod_mismatch,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r WHERE r.reason_code IS NULL) null_reason,
 (SELECT MIN(return_date) FROM r) mind, (SELECT MAX(return_date) FROM r) maxd

calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND cp.category='Garden' THEN r.quantity_returned END) as_is_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND p.category='Garden' THEN r.quantity_returned END) as_was_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND s.store_id=999 THEN r.quantity_returned END) store999
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
